text:
Sarah L: Heads up — seeing a spike in UNASSIGNED leads from the EU virtual summit registration between 09:00-11:00 CET. ~120 leads where HubSpot owner stayed blank and went into the fallback queue.
Mike G: Ugh. Any pattern? form id / UTM?
Sarah L: Mostly same form id: /forms/summit-eu-2026. UTM consistent. Logs show the RR assignment step returned 200 but payload had owner_id: null.
Tara R: I pulled a sample and HubSpot webhook payload looks fine. The round-robin service response is where owner is null. I can paste one: 
```
{\n  "lead_id": "L-4920",\n  "assigned_to": null,\n  "rotation_index": 5,\n  "timestamp": 1766011200\n}
```
Raj P: Quick hypothesis: rotation pointer uses epoch-second seeding in UTC, but we had a DST shift on the EU region windows yesterday. If the seeding logic does modulo by day-of-year without normalizing timezone, pointer may shift by +1 for a ~2hr window. I've seen similar off-by-one when service restarts cross midnight in local tz.
Mike G: Can we confirm? Any repro in staging?
Raj P: I reproduced locally by simulating leads with timestamp in CET vs UTC; rotation_index calc is: 
```
rotation_index = (last_index + ((timestamp / 3600) % team_size)) % team_size
```
Which is wrong — using hour-of-day mod team_size yields a timezone-dependent bump. Should be strictly (last_index + 1) % team_size.
Tara R: Nice catch. Ops -> quick mitigation options?
Sarah L: Business asks: fix fast. SLA for claim is 120s for VIP & 300s for standard. Right now many leads sit unclaimed for >10m. Need ASAP mitigation + rollout plan.
Raj P: Short-term patch (safe): change rotation to deterministic + fallback owner mapping for EMEA to a steward account. Steps: 
- deploy config change to force rotation_index = (last_index + 1) % N
- set fallback_owner for form id "summit-eu-2026" -> "EMEA Oncall" (temp)
- increase claim timeout for summit form to 120s -> 300s to give workers more time during rollout
Tara R: I can push the fallback_owner change in HubSpot workflow and update the routing map in 1-2 minutes. Mike, can you update ops playbook and notify sales?
Mike G: On it — I'll message Sales ops and update the handoff doc. Also will kick a small canary: route 10% of summit leads to patched RR service first.
ops-bot: deploy-check: branch=fix/rr-dst-patch, build=ok, tests=passed
Raj P: After canary looks good (10-15 mins), promote to 100%. Rollback plan: revert fallback_owner and config. I'll add a regression test to assert rotation math not dependent on tz.
Sarah L: Agreed. Tara, Mike — please monitor HubSpot unassigned queue and slack alert #marketing-leads. If >5 unassigned in 15m, rollback to fallback-only and escalate.
Tara R: Patch applied: fallback_owner set, claim timeout increased. I also added a heartbeat probe that posts to #marketing-leads every 10m with unassigned-count.
Mike G: Notified Sales Ops + execs. Can we capture a short postmortem after? Just notes for QBR.
Raj P: Can confirm canary looks clean so far (0 null-assigned in 10m sample). Will ship full rollout in 12m.
Sarah L: Thanks all. Will watch and update here. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy: success -> fix/rr-dst-patch rolled to 100% at 1766012458
